summary: Ephemeral runner secret injections fail after Vault KV-V2 mount path rename during migration
description:
Issue summary: During an automated migration to standardize Vault KV-V2 mount paths, a subset of ephemeral CI runners started failing to receive injected secrets. Impact: multiple release jobs (nightly and some canaries) returned credential-errors causing build artifacts to fail and downstream deploys to stall. Affected tenants are internal release pipelines and a handful of engineering projects that use ephemeral runners with Vault-based secret injection.

Observed behavior: ephemeral runner pods start, init-containers return healthy, but the in-pod vault-agent reports 404 when trying to read /secret/data/projects/<project>/ci-token after the mount path rename. The runner then exits with 1 and job marked FAILED. No broader Vault outages were reported.

Expected behavior: vault-agent should successfully read secrets from the new KV-V2 mount path, inject credentials into the runner environment, and allow jobs to run to completion.

Immediate business impact: blocked nightlies for two teams and delayed one minor release. Workaround required manual job rerun using a temporary templated secret path mapped in CI.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) On a cluster with ephemeral-runner operator configured for Vault KV-V2 secret injection, rename the KV-V2 mount from 'secret' to 'secret-engine' using vault mount command as in the doc
2) Allow the migration script to create a canonical redirect but do not update existing CI secret templates
3) Trigger a pipeline that provisions an ephemeral runner that expects secret path 'secret/data/<proj>/ci-token',
4) Observe vault-agent logs in the runner init-container and the runner exit code in the controller pod
5) Confirm 404 errors for vault kv read requests against old path and no automatic rewriting by secret-sync component
logs:
vault-agent[init]: GET /v1/secret/data/projects/foo/ci-token -> 404 
controller: ephemeral-runner-abc-123 container stderr: Failed to fetch CI creds: vault kv get failed with status 404
operator: secret-sync: template-resolve for project 'foo' returned unresolved path 'secret/data/projects/foo/ci-token'
Vault audit: request path=secret/data/projects/foo/ci-token, client=10.12.8.5, error=not found
investigation_notes: 10:15 - Maya verified Vault mount rename executed by infra-migration: 'secret' -> 'secret-engine' and migration script created new mount with data copy but left old mount in place as a peer alias for seven days

10:45 - Diego reproduced 404 locally by creating ephemeral runner with old template; observed that secret-sync operator resolves templates at job creation time and caches resolved path in runner annotation

11:20 - Hypothesis: secret-sync caches resolved KV paths using mount name present at template render time. When mount was renamed and template not re-rendered, runners still attempt old path and Vault does not return redirect for KV-V2 path renames (Vault returns not found).

12:05 - Confirmed inconsistent behavior: some older runners succeed because runner annotations were refreshed by a scheduled re-sync; newly provisioned runners fail because they read stale template from gitops config map
12:40 - Reviewed vault audit logs: reads consistently target the old path; no 403s or permission issues—only not found
13:00 - Temporary mitigation applied: we added a compatibility mount alias 'secret' -> 'secret-engine' on a subset of Vault instances to unblock failing pipelines while we plan full remediation
comments: Maya Chen (2026-03-10 10:30): Initial report after nightlies failed. Captured runner pod logs and Vault audit lines. Assigning to Infra SRE.

Diego Ramirez (2026-03-10 11:10): Reproduced in staging. Confirmed secret-sync caches resolved paths in annotations. Working hypothesis: cache + mount rename leads to 404s rather than transparent redirect.
Infra SRE (2026-03-10 12:05): Applied temporary compatibility mounts for teams A and B to unblock release jobs. This is a stop-gap and needs a coordinated migration plan.

Platform Eng (2026-03-11 09:20): We'll add a re-render job to the gitops pipeline to update CI templates and a short-term controller change to rewrite old mount prefixes to new mount names at runner creation time.

Diego Ramirez (2026-03-12 14:00): Implemented controller patch in draft PR to rewrite template paths; running canary against staging ephemeral runners. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2648
next_steps: 1) Merge controller patch that rewrites old KV mount prefixes to canonical mount name at runner instantiation (canary in staging). 2) Add a one-off gitops re-render job to update all CI secret templates to use 'secret-engine' canonical path. 3) Schedule removal of compatibility mount after 7 days post-re-render and confirm no failures. 4) Add telemetry alert for repeated kv read 404s from ephemeral runners. 5) Update runbook to include mount-rename checklist and template re-render step.
resolution: In progress - temporary compatibility mounts configured to unblock pipelines. Controller patch under review; full resolution requires gitops template re-render and scheduled compatibility mount removal. Post-resolution action: add migration checklist and automated template re-render job to prevent recurrence.
